items.title: 18.7.3 Ligand exchange ka complexes ke rang par asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.7.3 with Table 18.4 and Quick Check 18.5, printed pages 26-27.

blocks.text: Complex mein ligands badalne se metal ion ki splitting ki miqdar badal jati hai. Is liye jazb hone wali light ki frequency bhi badalti hai aur nazar aane wala rang badal jata hai. Har soorat mein naye ligands (NH₃ ya Cl⁻) asal H₂O ligands se zyada stable complex banate hain; is naye complex ka ΔE alag hota hai, is liye jazb hone wali frequency aur nazar aane wala rang bhi alag hota hai.

blocks.caption: Table 18.4 Ligand exchange aur rang ki tabdeeli

blocks.prompt: a) [Cu(H₂O)₄(OH)₂](s) ke zyada ammonia mein ghulne ka equation likhein.
b) Gulabi [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ conc. HCl se neela ho jata hai. d-orbital splitting se wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Chaar Cl⁻ chhe H₂O ki jagah lete hain aur octahedral ion tetrahedral [CoCl₄]²⁻ ban jata hai. Cl⁻ H₂O se kam splitting karta hai aur tetrahedral splitting waise bhi kam hoti hai, is liye ΔE ghatta hai; complex kam energy wali (red/orange) light jazb karta hai aur neela dikhta hai.

blocks.prompt: c) [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 4Cl⁻ → [CoCl₄]²⁻ + 6H₂O mein product ka coordination number aur shakal batayein.

items: Naye ligands ΔE badalte hain, is liye jazb hone wali frequency aur nazar aane wala rang badalta hai.
Cu: neela → gehra neela (NH₃) ya peela/sabz (HCl). Co: gulabi → peela (NH₃) ya neela (HCl).
